details: 按用户要求在根 README.md 增加新设备加入集群的一键流程：Linux 与 OpenWrt 安装命令、自动生成 Nexus API Ed25519 身份与 Nexus SSH 身份、注册 API/SSH 公钥、pending 后批准、通过 NEXUS_CLUSTER_SSH_HOSTS 触发全体终端 SSH 公钥同步，并说明 authorized_keys 只重写 Nexus 管理区块。批准流程使用仓库本地 scripts/approve_v3_devices.py，可显式指定 NEXUS_V3_REGISTRY_URL。

按用户要求继续整理 C:\Users\Bing\aurora\Workstation\Nexus：根目录不再散放 OpenWrt 运行时资产，将 openwrt_v3_agent.sh 与 openwrt_ed25519_signer.rb 移入 nexus_v3/assets/，并更新 install.sh 与测试引用；删除重复入口 docs/README.md 与 agent-council/integrations/README.md，将说明集中到根 README.md；保留 install.sh 作为唯一用户安装入口。

在 Oracle 部署并启动 nexus-chatgpt-remote.service，将其配置为使用 Oracle Registry、Oracle EU Broker、ThinkCenter CN Broker 和统一 NEXUS_V3_ADMIN_KEY；Caddy 新增 nexus-remote.bings.app 反代块并验证配置，但 Cloudflare DNS/origin 记录仍未指向当前 Oracle，外部仍 525；为获得立即可用入口，复用已正常的 nexus-global-api.bings.app，在该 Caddy 站点中新增 /health、/openapi.json、/api/* 到 127.0.0.1:18131 的路由，保留 /v3/* 到 Registry。公网端到端验证：Bearer 调用 /api/devices 返回 oracle/thinkcenter/n1/vsc/victus/victus-wsl 等 approved 设备；调用 /api/commands 在 thinkcenter 执行 hostname 返回 completed、exit_code=0、broker_region=cn、output=ThinkCenter。静态 ChatGPT Action OpenAPI server 更新为 https://nexus-global-api.bings.app。

修复 ChatGPT Action 导入兼容性：静态 OpenAPI server 占位符从 https://YOUR_NEXUS_REMOTE_HOST 改为与导入器 root origin 一致的 https://your_nexus_remote_host，并补充 components.schemas = {}；运行时 nexus_v3/chatgpt_api.py 的 /openapi.json 同步补充空 schemas 对象；README 与 integrations 文档同步更新占位符。

按用户要求将 Nexus 核心入口文档中文化：README.md、docs/README.md、AGENTS.md、agent-council/integrations/README.md；重写 ChatGPT Remote 控制提示词，明确规范设备 ID、Action 调用规则、任务回执字段、高风险操作确认和 VSC 约束；同步静态 Action OpenAPI 与 nexus_v3/chatgpt_api.py 运行时 /openapi.json 的中文标题、描述和响应说明，同时保持 operationId 稳定。

Extended nexus-dashboard Worker /status.json handling to prefer a server-side read-only status source when NEXUS_STATUS_SOURCE_URL and NEXUS_CHATGPT_API_KEY are configured, keeping Bearer credentials out of browser JavaScript. If the source is absent or unavailable, /status.json falls back to the R2 object route and the page falls back to its embedded snapshot. Deployed Worker version da0b7a12-d34d-4ced-825b-3f5ffce05239 and verified the public dashboard still serves dynamic status UI code without legacy Supabase/API-key strings.

按用户要求永久删除完全无用的旧归档与缓存：bak/legacy-20260808、tests/browser-bridge、dashboard/.wrangler，以及验证生成的 __pycache__。保留并恢复 council 机制到主线 agent-council/，包括 advisor_flow.py、agent_browser.py、council.py、web_council.py、web_board.py、herdr-plugin、tests 和旧 WEB_NEXUS_SYSTEM_PROMPT / nexus-task-api-openapi，同时保留当前 v3 ChatGPT Remote prompt/OpenAPI。修复 council 兼容性：web_council atomic write 并发临时文件名、同进程 per-path mutex、Python 3.10 tomli fallback。更新 README/docs/.ai/其他目标.md，删除 bak 引用并明确旧文件已删除、council 保留。验证：v3 + council tests 43 passed，py_compile、sh -n、ruby -c 通过。

整理本机 Nexus 文档结构：新增根目录 其他目标.md，用于承接旧 Supabase/v2.5/Browser Bridge/Agent Council/VSC inbound 等非主线目标和历史思想；将 docs/RECOVERY_RUNBOOK.md 与 docs/SECURITY.md 改写为当前 v3 事实；更新 README.md 与 docs/README.md；压缩 .ai 的 README、任务图谱、记忆、文献与参考、技术细节演进、评估与实验分析、成果归档、经验为当前 v3 运行上下文；将旧 .ai/结项报告-2026-08-06.md 归档到 bak/legacy-20260808/docs/ai-legacy/；将主线 pytest/python 缓存可恢复移动到 bak/legacy-20260808/generated-cache/。验证：py_compile、pytest 10 passed、sh -n、ruby -c 均通过。

Unified Victus Windows and Victus WSL into the Oracle/global Nexus v3 registry alongside oracle, thinkcenter, n1, and vsc; approved all six devices. Verified Nexus command execution for oracle, victus-wsl, victus, vsc, thinkcenter, and n1. Synced global /v3/ssh/authorized-keys to WSL root, Oracle root, ThinkCenter root, N1 root/dropbear, VSC user, and Windows Bing authorized_keys; each target contains six Nexus managed public keys. SSH using Nexus keys was verified among persistent tailnet nodes: WSL -> Oracle/ThinkCenter/N1/Windows, Oracle -> ThinkCenter/N1/Windows, ThinkCenter -> Oracle/N1/Windows, N1 -> Oracle/ThinkCenter/Windows, Windows -> Oracle/ThinkCenter/N1. VSC remains command-controllable through Nexus but cannot directly SSH to tailnet 100.x addresses from the HPC network, and VSC inbound rejects the newly added Nexus key due to HPC login key policy; VSC SSH still depends on the existing local vsc alias/credential or a future VSC portal key registration/jump host.

Updated dashboard topology and node list to derive colors from a unified dynamic state model: online, degraded, pending, offline, and unknown. The page now polls same-origin /status.json when available and safely falls back to the embedded snapshot without exposing admin/API secrets. Clicking a topology node or node-list row toggles that node's service panel open/closed; dragging a node no longer toggles services. Added Worker route for /status.json. Verified inline JavaScript syntax, Worker syntax, public R2 upload, Worker deployment, preserved AX3600-only LAN links, and absence of legacy Supabase/API-key strings.

Deployed and verified Nexus v3 agents on Victus Windows, Victus WSL, and VSC. Added Windows command runner support in nexus_v3/agent.py with platform-specific shell selection and verified contracts with 10 passing tests. Victus Windows installed under C:\Users\Bing\AppData\Local\NexusAgentV3, runs via Scheduled Task NexusV3Agent, uses local registry/broker http://127.0.0.1:18101 and http://127.0.0.1:18102, registered and approved with key_id sha256:f567017f1a2505120b10a921aa45f10eca6cf378b65e79484c8db97adb9c8f17. Victus WSL was already active and approved with key_id sha256:9aac5d0d36a5cdaa7f51b5b74399883bcf4ce2c7100fbd128a2f774e682a9f95. VSC installed in ~/.local/nexus-agent-v3, runs user-mode via nohup, uses https://nexus-global-api.bings.app and https://nexus-eu-broker.bings.app, registered and approved with key_id sha256:ad7b09414fc71a99d60d4ec8e8a243914df50d2907ea7550e9e857a60a8f9475. End-to-end jobs completed for victus-wsl, victus, and vsc.

Removed the direct N1-to-ThinkCenter LAN edge from dashboard topology. Kept AX3600-to-ThinkCenter and AX3600-to-N1 LAN edges, preserving the model where N1 and ThinkCenter connect through AX3600. Verified inline JavaScript syntax and public deployment at https://nexus.bings.app/ under Basic Auth.

Added draggable topology nodes and draggable layout panning to dashboard/index.html. Node positions persist as percentages and canvas pan persists as pixel offsets in browser localStorage under nexus:v3-dashboard-layout. Added Reset Layout control. Verified inline JavaScript syntax, public R2 deployment at https://nexus.bings.app/, AX3600 LAN link preservation, and absence of legacy Supabase/API-key strings.

Confirmed the authoritative current Nexus workspace is C:\Users\Bing\aurora\Workstation\Nexus with latest dashboard, v3 services, installer, and ChatGPT integration artifacts. Used Windows OpenSSH to access VSC as vsc35603. Cleared active VSC Nexus copies recoverably by moving /vsc-hard-mounts/leuven-data/356/vsc35603/aurora/Workstation/Nexus to Nexus.cleared-20260808-193526 and Nexus-next to Nexus-next.cleared-20260808-193603. Verified active Nexus and Nexus-next paths no longer exist on VSC; backups remain for recovery until explicitly permanently deleted.

Improved the restored Nexus dashboard topology without changing the overall legacy layout. Device services are no longer rendered as always-visible topology chips; clicking a topology node or node-list item opens the Node Services panel. AX3600 is now positioned as part of the China LAN and explicitly connected to both ThinkCenter and N1 with LAN links. Verified inline JavaScript syntax, absence of legacy Supabase/API-key strings, and public deployment at https://nexus.bings.app/ under Basic Auth.

Restored the older VSC-export Nexus dashboard layout from the Antigravity brain artifact while updating it for Nexus v3. The public page keeps the original compact header, stats bar, topology canvas, right sidebar node list, console panel, and task history. Removed legacy Supabase/API-key driven live command execution from the public page; console now shows a read-only message and v3 execution is routed through ChatGPT Action/MCP. Updated static status to Oracle Registry :18101, EU Broker :18102, nexus-agent, ThinkCenter CN Broker/Agent, N1 OpenWrt Agent, and SSH trust. Uploaded index.html to Cloudflare R2 and verified https://nexus.bings.app/ contains the restored layout and no old Supabase key strings.

Updated dashboard/index.html with an Oracle + Nexus visual topology, Cloudflare Worker/R2 dashboard status, Oracle Registry/EU Broker/Agent status, Tailscale registry endpoint, and SSH trust KPI. Uploaded index.html to the remote Cloudflare R2 nexus bucket and verified https://nexus.bings.app/ returns the new visualization under Basic Auth. Oracle verification: nexus-v3-registry, nexus-v3-eu-broker, and nexus-v3-agent were active; local health endpoints returned Registry 3.0.0 OK and EU Broker 3.0.1 OK; Tailscale Registry http://100.116.89.65:18101/v3/health returned OK.

Created current Cloudflare Worker/R2 dashboard source under dashboard/, uploaded v3 architecture page plus README/install/ChatGPT prompt/OpenAPI to the remote nexus R2 bucket, deployed Worker nexus-dashboard, rotated Basic Auth to AUTH_USER_V2/AUTH_PASS_V2 secrets, and verified authenticated 200 responses for /, /README.md, /install.sh, /openapi.json, /nexus_openapi.json, and /chatgpt-prompt.md. The old chat history only exposed legacy admin/nexus2026, which no longer matched live secrets. New credentials are stored outside the repository at /mnt/c/Users/Bing/.codex/secrets/nexus-dashboard-basic-auth.txt and in Bitwarden Secrets Manager project Nexus as NEXUS_DASHBOARD_URL, NEXUS_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME, and NEXUS_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD.

Created a new v3 clean architecture instead of further patching legacy Global API/Broker services. Added independent Registry, Broker, Python Agent, Linux installer, OpenWrt installer, OpenWrt shell Agent, and v3 contract tests.

Added a downloaded OpenWrt Ruby Ed25519 signer fallback because N1 OpenSSL 1.1.1w cannot sign Ed25519 with pkeyutl/dgst. Verified Ruby signer signatures against Python cryptography and kept OpenWrt Agent token-free.

Implemented local v2.6 Ed25519 device identity changes for Python Agents, OpenWrt Agent, installers, Global API patch, Broker patch, schema, tests, and docs. Pending release branch publication, remote service deployment, per-device install, approval, and public-key recording.

Completed ChatGPT-centered Claude/Gemini Web advisor flow with original-task-first canonical transcript, deterministic FULL_CONTEXT, real visible agent-browser backend, timeout resume without duplicate send, context byte telemetry, collision-safe task IDs, manual fallback, and 32 passing Windows tests.

Migrated thinkcenter-host-tunnel to Cloudflare Zero Trust Remote Managed mode, set up N1 proxy for GitHub, and updated nexus_system_prompt.md to formally define the Multi-modal Access Architecture (FastMCP, REST API, CLI wrapper).
Updated ChatGPT Custom GPT Actions OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec in nexus_system_prompt.md#appendix-a-openapi-31-规范内嵌单一事实源 and embedded full schema in nexus_system_prompt.md.
Pushed all refactored Nexus code, FastMCP server, and clean installer scripts to https://github.com/bingStat/desktop-commander-agent main branch.
Cleaned up desktop-commander legacy terms to nexus. Built dual-mode FastMCP server (STDIO and SSE) in mcp_server/ with security interceptor and Supabase Cloud integration.

Nexus v2.5-regional software/service acceptance completed: Global API 2.1.4, canonical device filtering, Victus worker timeout recovery, Profile 3 Playwright Bridge, Claude/Gemini four-turn cross-review, idempotency, 33/33 tests, secret scan, release commit 297d3db and tag nexus-v2.5-final-20260806. Full Windows reboot drill deferred to an approved maintenance window.
